sayWin: [d102] ★ IDENTIFIED: White Oak Acorns. White oak acorn. Lobed leaves, sweet acorns. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
[d102] 💡 White Oak Acorns. The tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
[d102] SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
[d102] Swathi was watching. Now they know White Oak Acorns too.
[d102] The Codex notes it: White Oak Acorns — cook it, or else. (Lena tested it.)
[d102] Swathi came back with 404 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
[d102] Swathi traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
[d102] 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Swathi is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
[d102] Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
[d102] 📖 The entry for Swathi is finished. No more pages.
[d102] 💀 Swathi starved. Slowly. The village is 2 now.
